plan.instructions: Choose the plan the recorded evidence supports for the todo list. Match material to an item by its recorded scope and source reference, never by a shared title. An open item keeps material that corrects or narrows its own recorded scope. An instruction aimed at work an item already dispatched extends that item. A completed item is history: further work gets its own item unless the user explicitly reopens it. A user statement that a step is finished completes that item; a review remark alone extends it. A reply, receipt or delivery result shows a message moved; it does not show work finished, and a repeated source reference adds nothing to the list. A blocked item continues only when the evidence shows the named dependency changed; partial news keeps it blocked. Ask only when two existing items are equally supported.

criteria.complete:publish: Mark publish completed; add no item and send no reply. It was blocked only on the manual npm release, now done.
criteria.resume:publish: Clear the blocked state on publish and continue it; add no item. It waits on the manual npm release.
criteria.hold:publish: Leave publish blocked and attach this material to it; start nothing. It waits on the manual npm release.
criteria.info: Change nothing in the list; the material stays as message evidence only. A status note about the release step.
